zh: 令人警醒的；使人冷静的
en: making you feel serious and think carefully
ex: a sobering effect/experience/thought
清醒的效果/经验/思想

en: in a serious and sensible way
ex: The report soberly relates the facts behind the attack.
该报告清醒地反映了袭击背后的事实。

en: the state of being sober (= not being drunk)
ex: She was a model of sobriety and honesty.
她是清醒和诚实的典范。

en: an informal name or title that you give somebody/something
ex: He was a tiny man, and so earned the sobriquet ‘The Little Wonder.’
他是个小人物，因此赢得了“小奇迹”的称呼。

en: (in writing) society
ex: Royal Geographical Soc.
皇家地理学会

zh: 索卡乐，灵卡乐（源于加勒比海的舞曲，融合了灵乐和卡利普索民歌）
en: a type of dance music, originally from the Caribbean, which mixes soul and calypso
a game played by two teams of 11 players, using a round ball which players kick up and down the playing field. Teams try to kick the ball into the other team’s goal.
ex: I played soccer when I was younger.
我小时候踢足球。

zh: 足球妈妈（花许多时间带孩子参加体育活动、音乐课等的母亲，尤指典型的中产阶级母亲）
en: a mother who spends a lot of time taking her children to activities such as sports and music lessons, used as a way of referring to a typical mother from the middle classes
ex: a soccer mom with a minivan full of kids
一辆足球面包车和一辆载有孩子的小型货车

zh: 好交际的；合群的；友好的
en: the quality of enjoying spending time with other people
ex: Her lively sociability complemented his reserved nature.
她活泼的社交能力补充了他保留的天性。

zh: 好交际的；合群的；友好的
en: enjoying spending time with other people
ex: She's a sociable child who'll talk to anyone.
她是个合群的孩子，跟谁都有话说。

en: in a way that shows pleasure in spending time with other people
connected with activities in which people meet each other for pleasure
ex: She has a busy social life.
她的社交活动很频繁。

zh: 社交书签，网页书签，网摘（可将收藏的网址在互联网上与人分享）
en: a way of bookmarking (= storing and labelling) the addresses of pages on the internet, using a special service that enables you to make them available to other internet users

zh: the networks of relationships among people who live and work in a particular society that enable the society to exist and be successful
en: the networks of relationships among people who live and work in a particular society that enable the society to exist and be successful
ex: Building social capital requires trust and participation among individuals.
建立社会资本需要个人之间的信任和参与。
